text: The Queen of the South Sea, an ancient goddess who devours the men she seduces, [curses the great granddaughter|who_suffers|heirs of old wrongs] of the one man who turned her serpent into a dagger. In 1989 the anthropologist Tania, studying the legend, dives to [the Queen's resting place|trigger|unsealing what was shut away] and is taken over. She massacres a nightclub, guns down a police station and hunts the pop singer Erica, [surviving even a burning car|rules|nothing can stop it], while Erica holds [the dagger her great-grandfather handed down|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
